mapper.select: SELECT c."COMMENT_NO" AS commentNo, c."MARKET_TYPE" AS marketType, c."MARKET_CODE" AS marketCode, c."CONTENT" AS content, c."USERNAME" AS username, c."CREATED_AT" AS createdAt, c."IMAGE_URL" AS imageUrl, p."FILE_NAME" AS profileFileName, COUNT(l."COMMENT_NO") AS likeCount FROM "MARKET_COMMENT" c LEFT JOIN "PROFILE" p ON c."USERNAME" = p."USERNAME" LEFT JOIN "MARKET_COMMENT_LIKE" l ON c."COMMENT_NO" = l."COMMENT_NO" WHERE c."MARKET_TYPE" = #{marketType} AND c."MARKET_CODE" = #{marketCode} GROUP BY c."COMMENT_NO", c."MARKET_TYPE", c."MARKET_CODE", c."CONTENT", c."USERNAME", c."CREATED_AT", c."IMAGE_URL", p."FILE_NAME" ORDER BY c."CREATED_AT" DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT c."COMMENT_NO" AS commentNo, c."MARKET_TYPE" AS marketType, c."MARKET_CODE" AS marketCode, c."CONTENT" AS content, c."USERNAME" AS username, c."CREATED_AT" AS createdAt, c."IMAGE_URL" AS imageUrl, p."FILE_NAME" AS profileFileName, COUNT(l."COMMENT_NO") AS likeCount FROM "MARKET_COMMENT" c LEFT JOIN "PROFILE" p ON c."USERNAME" = p."USERNAME" LEFT JOIN "MARKET_COMMENT_LIKE" l ON c."COMMENT_NO" = l."COMMENT_NO" WHERE c."MARKET_TYPE" = #{marketType} AND c."MARKET_CODE" = #{marketCode} GROUP BY c."COMMENT_NO", c."MARKET_TYPE", c."MARKET_CODE", c."CONTENT", c."USERNAME", c."CREATED_AT", c."IMAGE_URL", p."FILE_NAME" ORDER BY likeCount DESC, c."CREATED_AT" DESC LIMIT 50
